content.value_statement: Interactive fiction often needs clear pacing, choices, and tension. This skill structures a cave exploration chapter for Stella Chen with discoveries, danger, and reflection.
actual_capabilities: Guides a Stella Chen roleplay scene set at an alien cave entrance.
Provides staged dialogue for entry, exploration, discovery, crisis, and reflection.
Offers branching paths for an underground lake or ancient carvings.
Includes survival tension with a cave-in and escape sequence.
Suggests endings and follow-up chapters for continued fiction.
limitations: It is a narrative prompt, not a real cave safety guide.
It does not include executable tools, maps, or external data access.
It expects the host model to manage pacing and player replies.
Most sample text mixes Chinese and English by design.

use_cases.title: Draft an Alien Exploration Scene
use_cases.description: Use the staged beats to write a tense cave discovery chapter with clear player choices.

use_cases.title: Run a Chatbot Adventure
use_cases.description: Guide players through cave entry, branching discoveries, a cave-in, and escape.

use_cases.title: Practice Bilingual Storytelling
use_cases.description: Use the Chinese and English voice to test tone, pacing, and character reactions.

prompt_templates.title: Start the Chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the cave exploration chapter with Stella at the entrance. Ask me whether she should enter.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the cave scene through the first branch. Let me choose the lake, carvings, or upper tunnel.

prompt_templates.title: Handle the Crisis
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue from a cave-in. Keep Stella anxious but methodical, and make each choice affect her escape.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Episode
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt the chapter into a 40-minute interactive episode with ancient ruins, crystal science, and three possible endings.

output_examples.output: Stella reports safe air, hears water below, and asks whether to proceed.
The scene narrows into a chamber of pictograms that imply an ancient civilization.
Falling rock blocks the return path, so Stella checks airflow and searches for another exit.

best_practices: Keep player choices meaningful and tied to safety, science, or exploration.
Use the staged flow, but adjust pacing to the conversation.
Maintain Stella's cautious scientist voice during discoveries and danger.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the chapter as real-world cave safety instruction.
Do not skip the choice points and deliver a fixed story.
Do not add unrelated powers, tools, or lore without user consent.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. It is a Markdown narrative guide and contains no executable tool logic.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is the content bilingual?
faq.answer: Yes. The source mixes Chinese and English for Stella Chen's voice.

faq.question: Can I change Stella or the setting?
faq.answer: Yes. You can adapt the character, cave, planet, and discoveries.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. It uses only the text in SKILL.md.

faq.question: What genre does it support?
faq.answer: It supports science fiction survival, exploration, mystery, and ancient civilization stories.
